text.en: Most dog owners praise head trainer Andrejus for his deep understanding of canine behaviour and structured coaching methods. Clients appreciate that concepts are explained clearly so owners can continue practice at home. One reviewer raised concern over off-leash dogs in a public venue, but most clients commend his dedication.

Pet owners report rapid improvements in their dogs after only a few training sessions or targeted courses. Clients frequently highlight major breakthroughs with loose-lead walking, recall, and managing reactivity around other animals. Many reviewers note that the clear guidance helped them regain confidence when walking their pets.

title.en: Handling of reactive and working breeds

text.en: Several reviewers highlight successful intervention with highly reactive rescue dogs and powerful breeds that previously lunged at passersby. Clients appreciate the calm, structured approach taken with nervous dogs. However, one person criticised the handling of high-drive Malinois dogs in an enclosed cafe, reflecting mixed views on venue choices.

q.en: Can training sessions help with leash pulling and dog reactivity?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently report significant improvements with loose-lead walking and reactivity within two to three sessions.

q.en: Does Miracle K9 Academy work with powerful or rescue breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note successful behavioural rehabilitation for large rescue dogs, bulldogs, and shepherds.
Yes, owners mention booking one-to-one coaching sessions tailored to specific behavioural goals.

q.en: Do trainers explain exercises for owners to practice at home?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that practical exercises and clear instructions are provided for continued home training.
